Overview

Sankt Pölten is a city in Lower Austria with a population of 55,514. The capital of Lower Austria, a historic city with a Baroque cathedral, modern government district, and a strategic location between Vienna and Linz. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
